rows.en: There's no one here.
Heheh! Go on and have yourselves some fun!
When everybody's having fun, I'm having fun too!
The "Ultra Cube" sounds like a chilly place...
When it's cold like that, win some coins here at the casino and get all warm and toasty!
There's a whole bunch of items on display in the "Shocker Cube"!?
I want those items... I wanna line 'em up as casino prizes...
Everybody's got it rough... Everybody's so busy...
But Kanegon Casino gets lonely when nobody comes to visit...
Even if it's just for a breather, come on by, won't ya?
You look super tired, y'know? Are you okay?
At times like that, come let loose and have a blast at the casino!
There's no one here.
I've been examining the items that were buried away. They're quite interesting.
Our technologies may differ, but the way we think is remarkably similar.
Thank you for saving Mebius. I'm truly grateful.
Next is Bogal. Defeat it in my place! I'm counting on you!
Still, you really did defeat Bogal. I can never thank you enough.
Now then... I need to hurry with the Memory Gadget repairs.
Well? Was the Denden Sensor of any use?
Well done!! I believed you'd pull it off.
Ah, Methuss is fine. She's resting in the medical room.
Since then, have you found any leads on Kamen Riders 1 and 2?
What? A desert-like world? So there was a place like that, too...
I hope we find Kamen Riders 1 and 2...
{8074}, thank you for saving me. I've had a good rest and gotten my strength back.
Methuss, are you all right now?
Yes. From now on, I'll be backing everyone up at the "Item Lab."
I'll keep exploring the Begins Cube a while longer, but I'll drop by here now and then.
Looks like there are all sorts of facilities here. I'll take a look around.
How are things on your end? I heard it's a desert. That's a harsh environment.
You've already cleared three missions? I think a little better of you now.
How does the Ride Machine handle? If there are any problems, I'll fix them right away.
So Kamen Riders 1 and 2 weren't in this Cube...
For now, it seems best to focus on defeating The O and rescuing RX.
...The enemy is after the King Stone?
So they're trying to get their hands on the technology of every world.
So a third Cube has finally been found. It's the one the enemy calls the "Hideout Cube," right?
...So you met Rider 2 and Skull. I'm glad they're safe.
But Skull... That's not a name I've heard before.
Kamen Rider Skull... The Boss is my mentor.
So he was pulled into this world, too?
That's the thing, I don't know... Skull should've died months ago.
Right in front of my eyes...
Skull was a fake!?
Yeah... Damn it, of all people, I fell for it. Thinking a fake like that was the Boss...
But it couldn't be helped. The Dummy Dopant's mimicry was perfect.
What a troublesome enemy to have appeared.
Well? Have you found the Polymer Plaster Bomb?
According to Ankh, the room with that "birdlime"-like substance looks suspicious...
Looks like you got the Polymer Plaster Bomb. Shove it right into the Modified Bemstar's belly!
Well done! Taking down that Modified Bemstar is quite something.
But be careful. Yapool is notorious for holding a grudge.
What? ...Crosses? And the Ultra Warriors are there...!!
A creature like black smoke...? So it had possessed Gomora...
Just what is the enemy plotting...?
DG Cells... I'm afraid I don't know them well. But I'll look into them for the future...
What!? DG Cells in a Choju...!? ...The enemy's research seems quite advanced.
So the path has been blocked... In that case, all you can do is take another route.
I'm no fan of detours, but it can't be helped. Let's find another way.
To rescue the crucified Ultra Warriors, we need to destroy the boulders blocking the path.
If only there were a suitable bomb somewhere...
What's the holdup? Hurry and save the Brothers.
How many crosses were there in all? There must be more Ultra Brothers crucified out there.
Please, hurry and rescue them.
How many crosses were there in all? There must be more Ultra Brothers crucified out there.
Please, hurry and rescue them.
Yapool will surely resort to cunning tricks. Be very careful.
The Ride Machine's drill is powered up. Now it should break through Ride Dungeon walls, too.
Hurry to the "Ultra Cube."
The "Ultra Cube" is frozen?
...What on earth could be causing it?
You should be able to reach the Plasma Spark Tower by way of the Colosseum.
It seems you've fully recovered.
"Regis Fight"? So that's the "game" Belial spoke of.
And on top of that, he'll grant the winner control of the Cube...
Just what is he thinking...!!
I never imagined Jack and the others would lose...
Their opponent was the Alien Alliance, a formidable foe. It couldn't be helped.
What's more, I hear they brought out Black King partway through.

notes.note: SPEAKERS: the slice labels for TalkMessCommand were wrong (Zoffy/Rider 1/God Gundam/00/Wing Zero). Re-derived from Event/Base/Command/Talk01_NN.bla: row = that script's TextIdOffset const + n + 1. Result: #0.16-0.59 Hikari; #0.60/#0.62 Methuss, #0.61 Hikari; #0.67-0.82 Accel; #0.92-0.137 Hikari except #0.126/#0.128/#0.129/#0.135 W (Shotaro) and #0.136 W (Philip); #0.147-0.243 Hikari except #0.210 Zero; #0.248-0.281 Zoffy; #0.282 Ultraman; #0.283 Seven. Casino rows #0.6-0.36 are all Kanegon (Talk01_02-06).
Talk01_01 in both rooms shows this line with no speaker: system text when the facility NPC is absent.
Pun on hokuhoku (steaming warm / pleased with winnings) after the 'cold Ultra Cube' line; rendered 'warm and toasty'.
Hikari uses ore here (personal vendetta: Bogal destroyed his planet). Bogal g=n -> 'it'.
Answers an implied question from the party about Methuss.
Methuss. {8074} = party leader name variable; padding dropped per brief.
'Glad they're safe' read as Rider 2 and Skull; could also mean the party. Uncertain.
W (Philip) per script (separate CHARA_NAME from Shotaro).
Quoted torimochi rendered "birdlime" (glossary Birdlime; lowercase as in story).
Source term (polymer plaster bomb) matched to glossary/story 'Polymer Plaster Bomb'.
Script names Zero (CHARA_NAME 15) as the second speaker; not a party variant.
Talk01_25 only plays offset+0; this second line is unused by the script. Treated as Hikari continuing.
Hikari says nii-san-tachi (the Ultra Brothers). Hikari isn't their sibling, so 'the Brothers' rather than 'my brothers'. Possibly a line first written for Mebius.
Duplicate of #0.235-0.236. Talk01_28 does not exist in the Command pack, so #0.242/#0.243 are unused; same English as the originals, speaker assumed Hikari.
Zoffy; addressee unstated (party or a just-recovered ally). Kept neutral 'you'.

report: 80/80. Slice speaker labels for TalkMessCommand were wrong; re-derived from Event/Base/Command/Talk01_NN.bla (TextIdOffset + n + 1). Uncertain: #0.124 referent of 'safe', #0.227 'the Brothers' from Hikari, #0.215/#0.242/#0.243 unused lines. No new names.
